fact: IRRI, sarmap and the national agricultural research institute ISRA piloted Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Landsat rice area, start-of-season and yield mapping in the Senegal River Valley in 2023 and extended it to Casamance in the 2024 wet season, aiming at transfer to Senegalese institutions.
title: Remote Sensing Applications for Rice Production Monitoring in Senegal
publisher: International Rice Research Institute, ISRA and sarmap (CGIAR Initiative on Digital Innovation)
